subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads, and should the first version be an explicit on-demand gated action/command rather than automatic session context injection?
rationale: The implementation can be bounded, but the feature expands agent-visible Telegram chat content and the issue proposes both explicit and automatic access paths with different security defaults.

options.title: On-Demand Gated Action First
options.body: Add a Telegram `list-pins` or read-pinned action/command that calls `getChat.pinned_message` only when invoked and guarded by a clear Telegram action/config setting.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Telegram Reads
options.body: Defer this issue into the broader Telegram message-read design tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12756 and decide the data-access model once for all reads.

options.title: Defer Automatic Context
options.body: Do not add session-start pinned context until maintainers separately approve storage, injection, and opt-in policy.

recommendation.title: On-Demand Gated Action First
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram `list-pins` or read-pinned action/command that calls `getChat.pinned_message` only when invoked and guarded by a clear Telegram action/config setting.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram action/runtime history and product/security-sensitive channel work make this the strongest routing candidate from the observed history.
